prerequisites: LEPL1401 (or LINFO1101) - fundamental concepts of programming (object-oriented), notions of analyzing a computer problem, designing, specifying and implementing a solution
LEPL1101 and LEPL1102 - transversal skills as developed in Projects 1 and 2

learning_outcomes.text: Develop a program in C language.
Verify by tests the correct functioning of a program.
Compare, analyze and criticize different programs.
Choose the metrics to measure the effectiveness of a program.
Document a program, its installation and its use.
Use a professional collaborative software development system.

syllabus_topics: Individual learning of the C language
Improvements of existing algorithms in C and comparison of programs inside the group
Peer-review of other groups' programs and improvement of the group's program
bibliography: Syllabus Langage C, accessible via https://sites.uclouvain.be/SyllabusC/
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
